description: entity-actions: the standard actions of a data model GENERATED from the module (owner decision 2026-10-13). The spec op writes a data model with every shape the generator decides on (an owner attribute, an active attribute, two references to one entity, a reference named after its entity, a self reference, a text identifier, unique keys, a date index, a static entity); ONE op entity-actions writes, per entity, Get<E>List (joins, filters, search, sort, paging), Get<E>ById, Save<E> (required, lengths, references, unique keys, owner, typed errors), Remove<E> (owner, records that still reference it; the active attribute set to False on Customer) and a service action each (public server actions); then a business action written as a logic text calls the generated ones. Everything reads back as its text (the text form of the logic op writes it). The corpus battery is tests/Shared/EntityActionsCorpusTests.cs.

flow:
/// Closes a ticket of the signed-in user: the generated read checks that it exists and is the user's, the generated save runs the data rules again.
server action CloseTicket public
  /// The ticket to close.
  in TicketId: Ticket Identifier
  /// The ticket as read, closed and saved.
  local Ticket: Ticket
  GetTicketById(Id=TicketId)
  assign  # Mark the ticket closed
    Ticket = GetTicketById.TicketRecord
    Ticket.TicketState = Entities.TicketState.Closed
  SaveTicket(TicketRecord=Ticket)
  end
